row:
My name is Dr Lianne and I'm a veterinarian! 

I graduated from The University of Queensland, Australia as Class of 2020 and currently work as a small animal GP vet in Auckland, New Zealand.

I share my experiences and help others to achieve their dreams of becoming veterinarians. I post informative content such as how to study for vet school but I also post "fun" content such as "Day in the life of" and placement stories. 

The posts on this site are my own and do not necessarily represent my workplace or the UQ School of Veterinary Science’s positions, strategies, or opinions.
